fusions.name: Rust Seeding
fusions.desc: Fires a rusted spore-pellet that deals 12 damage, leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds and [Sundered] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Red Dust Bloom
fusions.desc: Releases a cloud of rust spores in a cone 5 tiles ahead, dealing 26 damage that ignores armour to each enemy caught.

fusions.name: Rust-Cap Hedge
fusions.desc: Grows a 5-tile line of rusted iron fungus ahead of you for 8 seconds. Enemies that cross it are [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Grows Through Plate
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. You have 8% physical resistance.
